note: Corrections for forms. 'matches' forces which PokéAPI form a game form is matched to ("dex-form": "pokeapi-form-identifier"); 'patches' corrects fields of finished forms by form ID. Each entry can have its own "note" saying why.

maushold.note: Showdown's plain "Maushold" is the Family of Three; the Family of Four (this form) is "Maushold-Four".
